The process

How Northstar Pantry works

Every Friday, a complete dinner plan for your family drops into your inbox. Here's what goes into it — and what you get out of it.

01

You share a bit about your family

In under two minutes, you tell us how many people you're feeding, which nights you actually cook (we build in the flex), and any ingredients your family skips — shellfish, cilantro, eggplant, whatever it is.

You set the basics

  • ✓ Family size (2–8 servings)
  • ✓ Nights per week (3, 5, or 7)
  • ✓ Skip list (ingredients or whole categories)
  • ✓ Flavor comfort zone (mild → adventurous)
02

We build your plan, every Friday

Our team — real humans who cook for their own families — puts together your week. The recipes are tested in home kitchens, not restaurant ones. Portion sizes actually feed a family.

Each plan includes

  • ✓ A Monday–Sunday dinner schedule with flex nights marked
  • ✓ Estimated cook times for every recipe
  • ✓ Notes on which nights can be swapped
03

One shopping list, one store run

Your list is organized by grocery store section — produce, protein, dairy, pantry — so you can move through the store without backtracking. Designed for one weekly trip.

The list shows

  • ✓ Quantities already scaled to your family size
  • ✓ Pantry items you likely already have (marked separately)
  • ✓ A 'grab extras' note for nights when you need something quick
04

You cook, we refine

After each week, you can tell us what landed and what didn't. Over time, your plan gets smarter. We remember that your kids won't touch mushrooms and your partner requests salmon at least once a month.

What improves over time

  • ✓ More of what your family loves
  • ✓ Fewer swaps and substitutions
  • ✓ Seasonal awareness (we don't give you butternut squash in July)
What you get

Everything you need. Nothing you don't.

Weekly Dinner Plan

5 to 7 dinners, planned thoughtfully to balance variety, effort level, and what your family actually wants to eat.

Smart Shopping List

One list, sorted by section. Built for a single shopping trip. Scaled to your household size.

Pantry-First Recipes

Every recipe is written assuming you have the basics. We tell you exactly what you need to buy fresh.

Time Estimates

Every dinner comes with an honest cook time. We include 10-minute prep buffer because life happens.

Swap Nights

Need to move Thursday's pasta to Saturday? Our plans are designed to be reordered without breaking the shopping list logic.

Family Feedback Loop

Rate your dinners. Tell us what worked. Your plan learns your family's preferences over time.

Common questions

Things people ask us

Not at all. Northstar Pantry works with any grocery store — Kroger, Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, your local co-op, or wherever you already shop. We design the list to be store-agnostic.

We handle it. During setup, you'll share your skip list — specific ingredients, whole categories, or common allergens. Every recipe in your plan will respect those boundaries, no exceptions.

Meal kits ship you pre-portioned ingredients, which is convenient but expensive and generates a lot of packaging. We give you the plan; you shop your own store. That means lower cost, less waste, and you can actually adjust quantities based on what you already have at home.

Great news — that's the norm, not the exception. Every plan includes marked 'flex nights' for takeout, leftovers, or just cereal for dinner. You choose whether you want a 5-night or 7-night plan.

Every Friday by noon in your local time zone, so you can shop over the weekend and hit the ground running Monday.

Yes, absolutely. Month-to-month plans cancel with a click — no phone calls, no hoops.
